title: Her brother Philip Grace
summary: Brother Philip Grace died around 1954 and did not play music.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You had a brother, too. I know you were telling me about him, though, when I was here.
He's been dead. Since... Let's see. 50... 50... 54... He died. That's...
Mm-hmm. 54... All done. Well, what was it? What's his name, by the way?
His name was Philip. Philip Grace. Philip, my mother, son.

Did he play music? I'm trying to remember. I remember something about the... We talked about him before. Did he sing in church or something? No, he didn't sing in church. No, he didn't sing in church. He didn't play music.
